title: Deduplication and Record Merging
description: Resolution policies for consolidating identified duplicate records into single golden records.
conditions: Multiple updates for the same entity across disparate ingestion timestamps
Conflicting non-null values across duplicate candidate rows
recommended_methods: Source priority ranking (authoritative master system overrides secondary feeds)
selection_rules: If duplicate rows are byte-for-byte identical, drop all but the first occurrence
If duplicate rows contain complementary non-null columns, execute coalesced merge into unified record
If conflict exists in core attribute (e.g. conflicting date of birth), route to exception table
limitations: Last-Write-Wins may overwrite accurate historical data with empty fields from recent sync
Coalescing across many rows can create chimeric entities if keys were falsely matched
